'''Graham Halstead''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. He is currently affiliated with Ann Wright Representatives.

==Biography==
Halstead was born and raised in Virginia and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}} where he voiced [[Character of the day]] [[Locke]]. He later gained a more notable role in the form of recurring character [[Kanoa]]. Halstead is now living and working in Brooklyn, New York City.
